standards.description: Quote accurately from a text when explaining what the text says explicitly and when drawing inferences.
standards.ccssText: Quote accurately from a text when explaining what the text says explicitly and when drawing inferences from the text.

standards.description: Determine a theme of a story, drama, or poem from details in the text, including how characters respond to challenges; summarize the text.
standards.ccssText: Determine a theme of a story, drama, or poem from details in the text, including how characters in a story or drama respond to challenges or how the speaker in a poem reflects upon a topic; summarize the text.

standards.description: Compare and contrast two or more characters, settings, or events in a story or drama, drawing on specific details in the text.
standards.ccssText: Compare and contrast two or more characters, settings, or events in a story or drama, drawing on specific details in the text (e.g., how characters interact).

standards.description: Determine the meaning of words and phrases as they are used in a text, including figurative language such as metaphors and similes.
standards.ccssText: Determine the meaning of words and phrases as they are used in a text, including figurative language such as metaphors and similes.

standards.description: Explain how a series of chapters, scenes, or stanzas fits together to provide the overall structure of a particular story, drama, or poem.
standards.ccssText: Explain how a series of chapters, scenes, or stanzas fits together to provide the overall structure of a particular story, drama, or poem.

standards.description: Describe how a narrator's or speaker's point of view influences how events are described.
standards.ccssText: Describe how a narrator's or speaker's point of view influences how events are described.

standards.description: Analyze how visual and multimedia elements contribute to the meaning, tone, or beauty of a text.
standards.ccssText: Analyze how visual and multimedia elements contribute to the meaning, tone, or beauty of a text (e.g., graphic novel, multimedia presentation of fiction, folktale, myth, poem).

standards.description: Compare and contrast stories in the same genre on their approaches to similar themes and topics.
standards.ccssText: Compare and contrast stories in the same genre (e.g., mysteries and adventure stories) on their approaches to similar themes and topics.

clusters.name: Range of reading and level of text complexity

standards.description: By end of year, read and comprehend literature at the high end of the grades 4-5 text complexity band independently and proficiently.
standards.ccssText: By the end of the year, read and comprehend literature, including stories, dramas, and poetry, at the high end of the grades 4–5 text complexity band independently and proficiently.

standards.description: Quote accurately from a text when explaining what the text says explicitly and when drawing inferences.
standards.ccssText: Quote accurately from a text when explaining what the text says explicitly and when drawing inferences from the text.

standards.skillName: Determine two or more main ideas
standards.description: Determine two or more main ideas of a text and explain how they are supported by key details; summarize the text.
standards.ccssText: Determine two or more main ideas of a text and explain how they are supported by key details; summarize the text.

standards.description: Explain the relationships or interactions between two or more individuals, events, ideas, or concepts in a historical, scientific, or technical text.
standards.ccssText: Explain the relationships or interactions between two or more individuals, events, ideas, or concepts in a historical, scientific, or technical text based on specific information in the text.

standards.description: Determine the meaning of general academic and domain-specific words and phrases in a grade 5 informational text.
standards.ccssText: Determine the meaning of general academic and domain-specific words and phrases in a text relevant to a grade 5 topic or subject area.

standards.description: Compare and contrast the overall structure of events, ideas, concepts, or information in two or more texts.
standards.ccssText: Compare and contrast the overall structure (e.g., chronology, comparison, cause/effect, problem/solution) of events, ideas, concepts, or information in two or more texts.

standards.description: Analyze multiple accounts of the same event or topic, noting similarities and differences in the point of view they represent.
standards.ccssText: Analyze multiple accounts of the same event or topic, noting important similarities and differences in the point of view they represent.

standards.description: Draw on information from multiple print or digital sources, demonstrating the ability to locate an answer to a question quickly or to solve a problem efficiently.
standards.ccssText: Draw on information from multiple print or digital sources, demonstrating the ability to locate an answer to a question quickly or to solve a problem efficiently.

standards.description: Explain how an author uses reasons and evidence to support particular points in a text, identifying which reasons and evidence support which point(s).
standards.ccssText: Explain how an author uses reasons and evidence to support particular points in a text, identifying which reasons and evidence support which point(s).

standards.description: Integrate information from several texts on the same topic in order to write or speak about the subject knowledgeably.
standards.ccssText: Integrate information from several texts on the same topic in order to write or speak about the subject knowledgeably.

clusters.name: Range of reading and level of text complexity

standards.description: By end of year, read and comprehend informational texts at the high end of the grades 4-5 text complexity band independently and proficiently.
standards.ccssText: By the end of the year, read and comprehend informational texts, including history/social studies, science, and technical texts, at the high end of the grades 4–5 text complexity band independently and proficiently.

standards.description: Know and apply grade-level phonics and word analysis skills in decoding words.
standards.ccssText: Know and apply grade-level phonics and word analysis skills in decoding words.

subStandards.description: Use combined knowledge of all letter-sound correspondences, syllabication patterns, and morphology to read accurately unfamiliar multisyllabic words in context and out of context.
subStandards.ccssText: Use combined knowledge of all letter-sound correspondences, syllabication patterns, and morphology (e.g., roots and affixes) to read accurately unfamiliar multisyllabic words in context and out of context.

standards.description: Read with sufficient accuracy and fluency to support comprehension.
standards.ccssText: Read with sufficient accuracy and fluency to support comprehension.

subStandards.description: Read on-level text with purpose and understanding.
subStandards.ccssText: Read on-level text with purpose and understanding.

subStandards.description: Read on-level prose and poetry orally with accuracy, appropriate rate, and expression on successive readings.
subStandards.ccssText: Read on-level prose and poetry orally with accuracy, appropriate rate, and expression on successive readings.

subStandards.description: Use context to confirm or self-correct word recognition and understanding, rereading as necessary.
subStandards.ccssText: Use context to confirm or self-correct word recognition and understanding, rereading as necessary.

standards.description: Write opinion pieces on topics or texts, supporting a point of view with reasons and information.
standards.ccssText: Write opinion pieces on topics or texts, supporting a point of view with reasons and information.

subStandards.skillName: Introduce topic and logically group reasons
subStandards.description: Introduce a topic or text clearly, state an opinion, and create an organizational structure in which ideas are logically grouped to support the writer's purpose.
subStandards.ccssText: Introduce a topic or text clearly, state an opinion, and create an organizational structure in which ideas are logically grouped to support the writer's purpose.

subStandards.description: Provide logically ordered reasons that are supported by facts and details.
subStandards.ccssText: Provide logically ordered reasons that are supported by facts and details.

subStandards.skillName: Link opinion using words and phrases
subStandards.description: Link opinion and reasons using words, phrases, and clauses.
subStandards.ccssText: Link opinion and reasons using words, phrases, and clauses (e.g., consequently, specifically).

subStandards.description: Provide a concluding statement or section related to the opinion presented.
subStandards.ccssText: Provide a concluding statement or section related to the opinion presented.

standards.description: Write informative/explanatory texts to examine a topic and convey ideas and information clearly.
standards.ccssText: Write informative/explanatory texts to examine a topic and convey ideas and information clearly.

subStandards.description: Introduce a topic clearly, provide a general observation and focus, and group related information logically; include formatting, illustrations, and multimedia when useful.
subStandards.ccssText: Introduce a topic clearly, provide a general observation and focus, and group related information logically; include formatting (e.g., headings), illustrations, and multimedia when useful to aiding comprehension.

subStandards.description: Develop the topic with facts, definitions, concrete details, quotations, or other information and examples related to the topic.
subStandards.ccssText: Develop the topic with facts, definitions, concrete details, quotations, or other information and examples related to the topic.

subStandards.skillName: Link ideas with words and clauses
subStandards.description: Link ideas within and across categories of information using words, phrases, and clauses.
subStandards.ccssText: Link ideas within and across categories of information using words, phrases, and clauses (e.g., in contrast, especially).

subStandards.description: Use precise language and domain-specific vocabulary to inform about or explain the topic.
subStandards.ccssText: Use precise language and domain-specific vocabulary to inform about or explain the topic.

subStandards.description: Provide a concluding statement or section related to the information or explanation presented.
subStandards.ccssText: Provide a concluding statement or section related to the information or explanation presented.

standards.description: Write narratives to develop real or imagined experiences or events using effective technique, descriptive details, and clear event sequences.
standards.ccssText: Write narratives to develop real or imagined experiences or events using effective technique, descriptive details, and clear event sequences.

subStandards.skillName: Orient reader with narrator and situation
subStandards.description: Orient the reader by establishing a situation and introducing a narrator and/or characters; organize an event sequence that unfolds naturally.
subStandards.ccssText: Orient the reader by establishing a situation and introducing a narrator and/or characters; organize an event sequence that unfolds naturally.

subStandards.description: Use narrative techniques, such as dialogue, description, and pacing, to develop experiences and events or show the responses of characters to situations.
subStandards.ccssText: Use narrative techniques, such as dialogue, description, and pacing, to develop experiences and events or show the responses of characters to situations.

subStandards.description: Use a variety of transitional words, phrases, and clauses to manage the sequence of events.
subStandards.ccssText: Use a variety of transitional words, phrases, and clauses to manage the sequence of events.

subStandards.description: Use concrete words and phrases and sensory details to convey experiences and events precisely.
subStandards.ccssText: Use concrete words and phrases and sensory details to convey experiences and events precisely.

subStandards.description: Provide a conclusion that follows from the narrated experiences or events.
subStandards.ccssText: Provide a conclusion that follows from the narrated experiences or events.

standards.description: Produce clear and coherent writing in which the development and organization are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.
standards.ccssText: Produce clear and coherent writing in which the development and organization are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience. (Grade-specific expectations for writing types are defined in standards 1–3 above.)

standards.description: With guidance and support, develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach.
standards.ccssText: With guidance and support from peers and adults, develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach. (Editing for conventions should demonstrate command of Language standards 1–3 up to and including grade 5 here.)

standards.description: With some guidance and support, use technology to produce and publish writing as well as to interact and collaborate with others; demonstrate sufficient keyboarding skills to type two pages in a single sitting.
standards.ccssText: With some guidance and support from adults, use technology, including the Internet, to produce and publish writing as well as to interact and collaborate with others; demonstrate sufficient command of keyboarding skills to type a minimum of two pages in a single sitting.

clusters.name: Research to build and present knowledge

standards.description: Conduct short research projects that use several sources to build knowledge through investigation of different aspects of a topic.
standards.ccssText: Conduct short research projects that use several sources to build knowledge through investigation of different aspects of a topic.

standards.description: Recall relevant information from experiences or gather relevant information from print and digital sources; summarize or paraphrase information in notes and finished work, and provide a list of sources.
standards.ccssText: Recall relevant information from experiences or gather relevant information from print and digital sources; summarize or paraphrase information in notes and finished work, and provide a list of sources.

standards.description: Draw evidence from literary or informational texts to support analysis, reflection, and research.
standards.ccssText: Draw evidence from literary or informational texts to support analysis, reflection, and research.

subStandards.description: Apply grade 5 Reading standards to literature.
subStandards.ccssText: Apply grade 5 Reading standards to literature (e.g., "Compare and contrast two or more characters, settings, or events in a story or a drama, drawing on specific details in the text [e.g., how characters interact]").

subStandards.skillName: Apply reading standards to informational text
subStandards.description: Apply grade 5 Reading standards to informational texts.
subStandards.ccssText: Apply grade 5 Reading standards to informational texts (e.g., "Explain how an author uses reasons and evidence to support particular points in a text, identifying which reasons and evidence support which point[s]").

standards.description: Write routinely over extended time frames and shorter time frames for a range of discipline-specific tasks, purposes, and audiences.
standards.ccssText: Write routinely over extended time frames (time for research, reflection, and revision) and shorter time frames (a single sitting or a day or two) for a range of discipline-specific tasks, purposes, and audiences.

standards.description: Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions with diverse partners on grade 5 topics and texts, building on others' ideas.
standards.ccssText: Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on grade 5 topics and texts, building on others' ideas and expressing their own clearly.

subStandards.description: Come to discussions prepared, having read or studied required material; explicitly draw on that preparation and other information known about the topic.
subStandards.ccssText: Come to discussions prepared, having read or studied required material; explicitly draw on that preparation and other information known about the topic to explore ideas under discussion.

subStandards.skillName: Follow rules and take on roles
subStandards.description: Follow agreed-upon rules for discussions and carry out assigned roles.
subStandards.ccssText: Follow agreed-upon rules for discussions and carry out assigned roles.

subStandards.description: Pose and respond to specific questions by making comments that contribute to the discussion and elaborate on the remarks of others.
subStandards.ccssText: Pose and respond to specific questions by making comments that contribute to the discussion and elaborate on the remarks of others.

subStandards.skillName: Review key ideas and draw conclusions
subStandards.description: Review the key ideas expressed and draw conclusions in light of information and knowledge gained from the discussions.
subStandards.ccssText: Review the key ideas expressed and draw conclusions in light of information and knowledge gained from the discussions.

standards.description: Summarize a written text read aloud or information presented in diverse media and formats, including visually, quantitatively, and orally.
standards.ccssText: Summarize a written text read aloud or information presented in diverse media and formats, including visually, quantitatively, and orally.

standards.description: Summarize the points a speaker makes and explain how each claim is supported by reasons and evidence.
standards.ccssText: Summarize the points a speaker makes and explain how each claim is supported by reasons and evidence.

standards.description: Report on a topic or text or present an opinion, sequencing ideas logically and using appropriate facts and relevant descriptive details to support main ideas or themes.
standards.ccssText: Report on a topic or text or present an opinion, sequencing ideas logically and using appropriate facts and relevant, descriptive details to support main ideas or themes; speak clearly at an understandable pace.

standards.description: Include multimedia components and visual displays in presentations when appropriate to enhance the development of main ideas or themes.
standards.ccssText: Include multimedia components (e.g., graphics, sound) and visual displays in presentations when appropriate to enhance the development of main ideas or themes.

standards.description: Adapt speech to a variety of contexts and tasks, using formal English when appropriate.
standards.ccssText: Adapt speech to a variety of contexts and tasks, using formal English when appropriate to task and situation.

standards.description: Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English grammar and usage when writing or speaking.
standards.ccssText: Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English grammar and usage when writing or speaking.

subStandards.description: Explain the function of conjunctions, prepositions, and interjections in general and their function in particular sentences.
subStandards.ccssText: Explain the function of conjunctions, prepositions, and interjections in general and their function in particular sentences.

subStandards.skillName: Form and use perfect verb tenses
subStandards.description: Form and use the perfect verb tenses.
subStandards.ccssText: Form and use the perfect (e.g., I had walked; I have walked; I will have walked) verb tenses.

subStandards.skillName: Use verb tense to convey meaning
subStandards.description: Use verb tense to convey various times, sequences, states, and conditions.
subStandards.ccssText: Use verb tense to convey various times, sequences, states, and conditions.

subStandards.description: Recognize and correct inappropriate shifts in verb tense.
subStandards.ccssText: Recognize and correct inappropriate shifts in verb tense.

subStandards.description: Use correlative conjunctions.
subStandards.ccssText: Use correlative conjunctions (e.g., either/or, neither/nor).

standards.description: Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing.
standards.ccssText: Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing.

subStandards.description: Use punctuation to separate items in a series.
subStandards.ccssText: Use punctuation to separate items in a series.

subStandards.skillName: Use comma to separate introductory elements
subStandards.description: Use a comma to separate an introductory element from the rest of the sentence.
subStandards.ccssText: Use a comma to separate an introductory element from the rest of the sentence.

subStandards.skillName: Use comma to set off tag questions
subStandards.description: Use a comma to set off the words yes and no, to set off a tag question from the rest of the sentence, and to indicate direct address.
subStandards.ccssText: Use a comma to set off the words yes and no (e.g., Yes, thank you), to set off a tag question from the rest of the sentence (e.g., It's true, isn't it?), and to indicate direct address (e.g., Is that you, Steve?).

subStandards.skillName: Use underlining or italics for titles
subStandards.description: Use underlining, quotation marks, or italics to indicate titles of works.
subStandards.ccssText: Use underlining, quotation marks, or italics to indicate titles of works.

subStandards.description: Spell grade-appropriate words correctly, consulting references as needed.
subStandards.ccssText: Spell grade-appropriate words correctly, consulting references as needed.

standards.description: Use knowledge of language and its conventions when writing, speaking, reading, or listening.
standards.ccssText: Use knowledge of language and its conventions when writing, speaking, reading, or listening.

subStandards.description: Expand, combine, and reduce sentences for meaning, reader/listener interest, and style.
subStandards.ccssText: Expand, combine, and reduce sentences for meaning, reader/listener interest, and style.

subStandards.description: Compare and contrast the varieties of English used in stories, dramas, or poems.
subStandards.ccssText: Compare and contrast the varieties of English (e.g., dialects, registers) used in stories, dramas, or poems.

standards.description: Determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words and phrases based on grade 5 reading and content.
standards.ccssText: Determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words and phrases based on grade 5 reading and content, choosing flexibly from a range of strategies.

subStandards.description: Use context as a clue to the meaning of a word or phrase.
subStandards.ccssText: Use context (e.g., cause/effect relationships and comparisons in text) as a clue to the meaning of a word or phrase.

subStandards.skillName: Use Greek and Latin affixes and roots
subStandards.description: Use common, grade-appropriate Greek and Latin affixes and roots as clues to the meaning of a word.
subStandards.ccssText: Use common, grade-appropriate Greek and Latin affixes and roots as clues to the meaning of a word (e.g., photograph, photosynthesis).

subStandards.description: Consult reference materials to find the pronunciation and determine or clarify the precise meaning of key words and phrases.
subStandards.ccssText: Consult reference materials (e.g., dictionaries, glossaries, thesauruses), both print and digital, to find the pronunciation and determine or clarify the precise meaning of key words and phrases.

standards.description: Demonstrate understanding of figurative language, word relationships, and nuances in word meanings.
standards.ccssText: Demonstrate understanding of figurative language, word relationships, and nuances in word meanings.

subStandards.description: Interpret figurative language, including similes and metaphors, in context.
subStandards.ccssText: Interpret figurative language, including similes and metaphors, in context.

subStandards.description: Recognize and explain the meaning of common idioms, adages, and proverbs.
subStandards.ccssText: Recognize and explain the meaning of common idioms, adages, and proverbs.

subStandards.description: Use the relationship between particular words to better understand each of the words.
subStandards.ccssText: Use the relationship between particular words (e.g., synonyms, antonyms, homographs) to better understand each of the words.

standards.description: Acquire and use accurately grade-appropriate general academic and domain-specific words and phrases.
standards.ccssText: Acquire and use accurately grade-appropriate general academic and domain-specific words and phrases, including those that signal contrast, addition, and other logical relationships (e.g., however, although, nevertheless, similarly, moreover, in addition).
